title: Idempotent completeness of the rationalized category
statement:
Fix the finite-field datum [def-weil-finite-field-fiber] $p,a,q,k_0,k$ with $q=p^a$, a prime $\ell\ne p$, an algebraic closure $\Qlb$ of $\Ql=\mathbf Q_\ell$ [def-weil-algebraic-closure], and a finite extension $E/\Ql$ contained in $\Qlb$, with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $Y$ be a finite-type $k$-scheme [def-weil-finite-type-morphism], and let $D^b_c(Y,E)$ be the raw rationalized category of [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi]. Then $D^b_c(Y,E)$ is idempotent complete, and the canonical functor

$$
 D^b_c(Y,E)\longrightarrow\Kar\bigl(D^b_c(Y,E)\bigr)
$$

into its Karoubi envelope [def-weil-karoubi-envelope] is an exact equivalence.

proof.text: Put $\mathcal T=D^b_c(Y,E)$, the triangulated raw scalar localization of [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi]. Apply the rational standard-t-structure assertion of [def-weil-constructible-heart], whose legacy Lean declaration WeilConjectures.rationalConstructibleStandardTStructure_existsUnique is on exactly rationalConstructibleCategory D l hl E Y. It supplies a t-structure t together with objectwise boundedness; retain only these witnesses. The finite-field datum, coefficient field, and finite-type scheme hypotheses are exactly those in the present statement. Unlike the current intrinsic prop-constructible-truncations interface, this declaration needs no comparison of coefficient categories or replacement of E by a small model.

source.place: Opening rationalized standard bounded t-structure assertion, using the standard-t-structure clause of def-weil-constructible-heart

proof.text: Apply the two declarations of [thm-weil-karoubian-bounded-t] to t and its objectwise boundedness. TStructure.isIdempotentComplete_of_bounded gives splitting of all idempotents; TStructure.isEquivalence_toKaroubi_and_isTriangulated_of_bounded gives equivalence and exactness of the canonical functor of [def-weil-karoubi-envelope]. Combine these assertions as the required conjunction. The input and output are the original raw rationalized category, with its original triangulation.

source.place: Final sentence: the same conclusion follows from the bounded t-structure alone

proof_origin.place: Opening bounded-standard-t-structure assertion and final bounded-t Karoubian alternative; K6 uses the existing legacy standard-t-structure declaration of def-weil-constructible-heart

The purported substitution T=Y fails, e.g. for Y=Spec(F_ell), and finite-type scope fails for an infinite disjoint union of Spec(k). The repaired statement exposes the finite-field datum, ell distinct from p, and finite-type k-scheme scope appropriate to the available rational-stage truncation theorem. These are explicit failed hypothesis checks, not claimed counterexamples to abstract idempotent completeness. No equality between the detailed integral category and the separate PBC category with compatible etale-origin witnesses is asserted.
